seo.title: Count Easy — Day Countdown for iPhone
seo.description: The days until the moments that matter, and the days since the ones that changed things. Add a countdown in a sentence, see your next moment in widgets, share it as an image. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: COUNTDOWN TRACKER
hero.title: The days until what matters.
text: Count down to a trip, a birthday or a launch, and count up from the day you moved or quit something. Type it in a sentence and Count Easy does the rest. No sign-up, no subscriptions, no data collection.

items.title: What's next, first
items.text: Home leads with your next moment, like "12 days until Lisbon trip", and a thin bar for how much of the wait is behind you.

items.title: Add it in a sentence
items.text: Type "Lisbon trip June 3" or "Mom's birthday May 4" and Count Easy reads the name, the date and whether it repeats. Or use the full form for an icon, a color and a note.

items.title: Days until and days since
items.text: Count down to trips, birthdays, weddings and deadlines, or count up from the day you moved, started a job or quit something. On the day itself, it simply reads Today.

items.title: Repeats that keep their day
items.text: Every day, week, two weeks, month or year. Birthdays come back every year, February 29 included in leap years.

items.title: Right, wherever you are
items.text: Count Easy counts calendar days, so a countdown never shifts by a day when you travel or the clocks change.

items.title: Widgets
items.text: Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show your next moment, or any countdown you pick. The medium and large sizes list what's up next.

items.title: Share the countdown
items.text: Send any countdown as an image, in Paper, Ink or Story.

items.title: Your accent
items.text: Pick one of eight accents to mark your next moment. It sets the app icon too, with dark and tinted versions, and the widgets.

items.title: Day or night
items.text: Follow your iPhone or pick Light or Dark. After dark, choose soft Graphite or true OLED Black.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your dates. Your device.
text: No accounts. No cloud sync. No tracking. No ads. Count Easy keeps everything on your device, shared only with its own widgets. Your data never leaves.

cta.title: Start counting.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
